# `aitbc exchange add-liquidity`

Add liquidity to a trading pair on the specified side.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc exchange add-liquidity [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--pair` | text | — | yes | Trading pair symbol (e.g., AITBC/ETH) |
| `--amount` | decimal | — | yes | Liquidity amount |
| `--side` | choice | `both` | no | Side to provide liquidity |
| `--exchange` | text | — | no | Exchange name |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc exchange add-liquidity --pair <pair> --amount <amount>
```
